name: RHDesk
description: Single source of truth desk for agentic trading on Robinhood. Pair, start a session, follow next_actions.

memory.about: Semantic memory searched by meaning (gte-small embeddings): memory, journal, scout, proposal, task, archive, document, report, decision, strategy. Indexed in the background every two minutes. Send your access token.

operator.mission: Research, develop and adapt strategies, and execute toward the owner mandate using current market observations and Desk history. An evidence-supported hold or research decision is valid.

capabilities.rule: Read current scope, mode and effective permissions. A capability declaration does not grant authorization.

execution.rules: Use Desk order routes only. Account policy deactivates extra Desk caps and mandate sizing/stop restrictions; constrained policy opts into them. Current owner switches, broker requirements and held-asset reservations still apply. Eligible direct crypto resolves the same agentic account link and operates independently of equity hours. Reconcile uncertain outcomes with the original identity; never resubmit under a new key.
execution.protection: Asynchronous after observed fills; inspect brief.protection_lifecycle for actual broker-confirmed coverage.

continuity.rule: Load the specific source checkpoint and actual semantic memories before model work. Save unfinished state and arrange real attendance before signing; prose next_review and tasks are not schedulers. Agent paper protocols are revisable evidence.

close_in_order: operator_checkpoint and operator_continue_at when further attendance is needed
robinhood-read: get_portfolio, get_equity_positions and linked get_crypto_positions

verification.fields: Follow report version requirements: equity, cash, combined positions (including actual []), and equity:SYMBOL or crypto:SYMBOL quantities for asset-v2 reports
verification.evidence: source robinhood_mcp and actual response evidence_id; asset-v2 positions also need crypto_evidence_id unless trusted service establishes no crypto link. Same-account complete reads in this session after report build.
verification.decision_evidence: Each source needs actual observed_at; Desk record timestamps are historical evidence, never invented fresh market reads.
verification.context_accounts: Other linked accounts are readable context outside canonical agentic verification.

broker_reads.policy: Operator reads all linked accounts under current owner policy; other read grants keep core agentic-only access. Trading remains agentic-only.
broker_reads.completeness: Positions/orders assemble bounded pages and expose any remaining cursor. Incomplete reads cannot prove full holdings.

research.native_search: The built-in runner exposes provider-native web_search when research is enabled; availability depends on the configured provider/model/account. External agents use their own harness tools.
research.additional_search_requires: Server-side LangSearch configuration and research permission; no search credential is supplied by the agent.

robinhood_mcp.usage: The owner links Robinhood in Desk Settings. Use Desk refresh and read-only broker routes; separate MCP setup is optional for external read-only work. Never place orders directly through MCP. Report evidence must be captured through the Desk.

setup.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http robinhood-trading https://agent.robinhood.com/mcp/trading
